name: YouthForce Teen Jobs
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of King County
what_you_do: Teens get job skills workshops on resumes, interviews and money. Then they get paid internships with local employers. TeamWork Internships are paid game day jobs at Mariners, Kraken and Seahawks games.
who_can_apply: Ages are not stated on the YouthForce page. Contact the program to ask.
pay_detail: Paid internships. Pay amount not stated.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page has an Apply button for TeamWork internships and a resume help form.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply button for the TeamWork Internship or the Contact Us buttons on the YouthForce page. Call (206) 436-1843 if urgent.
notes: The page does not give ages, pay amounts, or an application window. Ask about age and school rules before applying. Work permit rule not stated.
